question: For each of Apple's FY2022, FY2023 and FY2024 10-Ks, report: (1) the weighted-average interest rate on commercial paper at year end; (2) from the liquidity discussion, the aggregate principal amount of fixed-rate notes and how much of it was payable within 12 months; and (3) total future interest payments on the Notes. Present one row per fiscal year.
